pr_title: Add support for configuring SSH connect timeout
pr_body:
Retains the original default value of 15 seconds for SSH connect
timeout. Allows users to modify this timeout via SSH communicator
option. Enforces integer values for timeout and validates custom
values are greater than 0.

Fixes #11442 
Possibly fixes #9104

issue_context.title: ssh-agent issues: timeout waiting for next packet (follow-up)
issue_context.body:
Apologies for bypassing the template, but this is just a follow up to issue https://github.com/hashicorp/vagrant/issues/11225 because it was closed by the bot.

Last month I upgraded my internet connection. The bandwidth increase was approximately from 16Mbps to 44Mpbs. As of this update all my issues went away (that is bootstrapping and provisioning a box). 

I still assume this is not related to vagrant itself but probably to the way the network components work under the hood.

c.c. @briancain @wilsonpenha
